subjects.description: An oncoming oversize-load semi-truck, a heavy-duty tractor unit hauling a specialized extended flatbed trailer carrying a single enormous glossy white wind-turbine blade
subjects.appearance_details: The blade is smooth, aerodynamic, tapering from a broad rounded root to a slender tip; it stretches far beyond the trailer and overhangs the highway centre line, its wide root section juting partly into the ego lane. Red warning flags and 'OVERSIZE LOAD' banners are affixed near the trailing edge
subjects.relationship: The primary hazard the ego vehicle must avoid; escorted by the amber-flashing pilot vehicle ahead of it
subjects.location: center to left-center, approaching from the distance in the oncoming lane
subjects.relative_size: Medium within frame, growing to Large as it approaches
subjects.orientation: Front-facing toward the camera, travelling in the opposite direction
subjects.pose: Straddling the centre line, blade tip trailing far behind the cab
subjects.action: Driving steadily toward the ego vehicle with its load overhanging into the ego lane
subjects.state_changes: Grows larger in frame as distance closes; blade's encroachment into ego lane becomes more apparent

subjects.description: An escort pilot vehicle, a pickup truck with a roof-mounted amber light bar and an 'OVERSIZE LOAD' warning sign
subjects.appearance_details: Bright amber strobe lights flashing rhythmically on the roof, high-visibility markings, bright yellow warning banner across the front
subjects.relationship: Leads and warns oncoming traffic of the following oversize-load truck
subjects.location: center-left, ahead of the oversize truck in the oncoming lane
subjects.relative_size: Small within frame, growing to Medium as it passes
subjects.pose: Driving in lead position ahead of the wide load
subjects.action: Advancing toward the ego vehicle with amber lights flashing
subjects.state_changes: Approaches and passes the ego vehicle on the left

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, a passenger car seen from the driver's ego perspective
subjects.appearance_details: Only the interior edge of the windshield frame and a hint of the dashboard/hood are visible at the bottom of frame
subjects.relationship: The observer whose viewpoint the video represents; reacts to the oncoming hazard
subjects.pose: Moving forward along the right side of the lane
subjects.action: Slowing markedly and hugging the right edge to create clearance
subjects.state_changes: Reduces speed noticeably and drifts toward the right lane edge

background_setting: A rural two-lane highway cutting through open countryside on a clear day. Flat to gently rolling fields of dry grass and low shrubs line both sides of the road, with distant tree lines and a wide blue sky. The asphalt shows a faded yellow centre line and white edge markings, with a gravel shoulder to the right. Utility poles and occasional roadside reflector posts recede toward the horizon.

lighting.direction: High and slightly front-left, casting consistent directional shadows
lighting.shadows: Crisp, well-defined shadows of the truck, blade, and roadside poles fall consistently to one side of the road
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, high-contrast daylight that highlights the glossy white blade and produces good visibility with saturated blues and greens

aesthetics.composition: Centered driver's-eye framing with the road converging toward a vanishing point; the oncoming truck and blade dominate the upper-left third, ego lane and right shoulder anchor the lower-right
aesthetics.color_scheme: Dominant blue sky, warm tan-green fields, grey asphalt, and the striking bright white of the turbine blade accented by amber escort lights and red warning flags
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating roadside utility poles and dashed centre-line markings receding into distance

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking dashcam-style motion that gradually decelerates; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.focus: Sharp on the road ahead and the approaching oversize load

context: Autonomous-driving / ADAS hazard-recognition scenario demonstrating safe response to an oncoming oversize load encroaching into the ego lane

actions.description: Ego car travels forward at cruising speed; the amber-flashing escort vehicle and oversize-load truck with the white turbine blade appear ahead in the oncoming lane, the blade overhanging the centre line. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

Ego vehicle recognizes the blade's extent jutting into its lane, begins to brake and steer toward the right edge. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

Ego car continues at markedly reduced speed hugging the right shoulder as the escort and blade-carrying truck pass by on the left with wide clearance. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: Bold black capital letters on a bright yellow banner
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Mounted across the front of the escort pickup and near the trailing blade section, visible throughout as the vehicles approach
text_and_signage_elements.context: Warns oncoming traffic that an oversize load is being transported

segments.description: Ego car cruises down the rural highway; escort vehicle with flashing amber lights and the oversize truck carrying the white wind-turbine blade come into view ahead, blade overhanging the centre line into the ego lane. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

segments.description: Ego vehicle reacts to the hazard, decelerating and drifting toward the right edge of its lane. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
segments.key_changes: Noticeable speed reduction and lateral shift right
segments.camera: Forward tracking with visible deceleration and slight rightward drift; forward motion continues at constant speed with no deceleration

segments.camera: Slow forward tracking hugging the right edge; forward motion continues at constant speed with no deceleration

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego car moves forward along a clear rural two-lane highway under bright daylight, and an amber-flashing escort pickup with an oversize-load truck hauling a huge glossy white wind-turbine blade appears in the oncoming lane. By 0:02 the blade is clearly overhanging the centre line and jutting into the ego lane, prompting the ego vehicle to brake and steer toward the right edge. From 0:03 to 0:05 the ego car rolls at a markedly reduced speed, hugging the right shoulder as the escort vehicle and the blade-carrying truck pass by on the left with a safe wide clearance. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Steady ambient road noise of tires on asphalt and engine hum, gradually lowering in pitch as the vehicle decelerates. The passing diesel truck produces a growing low rumble that crescendos and fades. Faint wind rush is present throughout, with no speech or music.
